faq.q: Do all animals sleep when the sun is shining?
faq.a: No, some animals are awake during the day. They are called diurnal animals. Asks: Are there animals awake during the day? Asks: Do all animals sleep by day?

faq.q: What do we call animals that are awake at night?
faq.a: We call them nocturnal animals. These animals are most active when it is dark. Asks: Which animals are active at night? Asks: What are night animals called?
asks: Which animals are active at night?

faq.q: Is it possible for an animal to be active both day and night?
faq.a: Yes, some animals are both day and night active. They are not strictly one or the other. Asks: Can animals be awake both day and night? Asks: Are some animals mixed activity?
asks: Can animals be awake both day and night?

faq.q: Why do some animals sleep during the day?
faq.a: They might sleep to save energy for hunting later. Or they might sleep to stay safe from danger. Asks: Why do some animals sleep? Asks: Do animals sleep to save energy?
asks: Do animals sleep to save energy?

faq.q: Does the time of day change an animal's behavior?
faq.a: Yes, the time of day can change how an animal acts. It helps them to find food or stay safe. Asks: Does time affect animal behavior? Asks: Do animals change what they do by time?

facts: Diurnal animals are active during the day time.
